::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 12. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (2): P. 749
:::

Dear Miss Yonge
The colonial conscience exists as you see in relation to [copyright.](organizations/other_172.qmd) If you will kindly sign the enclosed receipt we will be able to recover for you munificent sum of 11/8d. for the wrong done you by the sale of Yankee reprints in British territory.

[I](people/person_939.qmd) am not going to America after all, & will, I trust have the pleasure of seeing you at my house when you come to London. Will you kindly give me as long notice as you can. I am going for a holiday, but could regulate it as to time.

Yours ever faithfully
Alex Macmillan
